item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on dual-use technology, cyber, biological, AI, and other catastrophic-risk domains. I found no credible 2024 evidence of a broader precaution-and-transparency strategy in cyber, biological, or AI policy. I also found no direct evidence of reckless handling in those domains. The available record is therefore narrowly nuclear-focused, with institution-building signals around safeguards and licensing, but little to no public evidence on the other catastrophic-risk areas named in the question.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh committed to non-proliferation, peaceful nuclear use: FM","publisher":"BSS","date":"April 30, 2024","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news-flash/186546","summary":"Bangladesh’s foreign minister said the state would keep the highest safety and security standards for nuclear plants and welcomed IAEA support for training and safeguards.
